_classes.name: Benefit receipt stored as a government duty (exemption/abatement amount schedule, actor_raw not in quote)
_classes.rule: re.search(r'\bshall (receive|be eligible to receive|be entitled to)\b[^.]{0,40}\b(abatement|exemption|credit|benefit)', quote, re.I); tighter subset adds actor_raw.lower() not in quote.lower()

_classes.name: Same-as-chapter effective date unresolved when the referenced chapter is named by bill print numbers ('as proposed in legislative bills numbers ...'); reference mis-resolved to the amended base chapter (672 of 1993)
_classes.rule: effective_dates[law].rule == 'same_as_chapter_unresolved' and re.search(r'legislative bills? numbers?', raw_clause, re.I) (resolvable via signed/{Y}.json print_no lookup)

_classes.name: Act-level dated sunset in the act clause not captured as expires_date when the clause opens with a proviso
_classes.rule: re.search(r'this act shall expire and be deemed repealed (on )?<Month> <day>,? <yyyy>', raw_clause, re.I) and not expires_date (43 of 48 such laws; 151 stored records in them)

_classes.name: Sibling duty missed in a multi-duty amended passage or unbraced free-standing section (second report, extended rule power, free-standing HPD certification, interest waiver, local-law content duty)
